question.text: How frequently does the FATF issue its public documents/statements identifying jurisdictions with weak AML/CFT measures?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that FATF issues its public documents/statements identifying jurisdictions with weak AML/CFT measures three times a year. The Trap: Candidates often guess annual or semi-annual frequency; monthly is too frequent for a global assessment cycle. The three-times-a-year figure is explicit in the workbook. Note: The point being tested is the frequency itself. Specific plenary months and any internal monitoring procedures are not stated in the workbook page checked.
